content.text: make the second load keep the cloned row

That is the real fix. The row cloner ran once per process and the second load found the list already built, so the clone landed on a menu that had gone away.

```
br-20260911-101500-ab12/er-quit-rows-debug.log
  rows: cloned 3 (build 1)
  rows: cloned 3 (build 2)   <- the second load, which used to print nothing
```

Both loads carry the row now, read out of the log the run wrote.
